mapper.select: select distinct t.glh as ldlp_no from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tssb_lsb t where sbid = #{sbid} order by ldlp_no
select distinct t.sbxh as sb_no from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mdt_tssb_lsb t where sbid = #{sbid} order by sb_no
select distinct t.sbxh as sb_no from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_db_tssb_lsb t where sbid = #{sbid} order by sb_no
select distinct t.sbxh as sb_no from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_gj_sbmx_lsb t where sbid = #{sbid} order by sb_no

select t.sz, t.jhpzh as zyfpNo, t.kprq as kpdate, t.cksp_dm as cmcode, t.sbhgspmc as cmname, t.hgjldwmc as cmunit, t.sl as qnt, t.jsje as amt, t.zssl as sl, t.zsse as se, t.tsl as tsl, t.tse as tsAmt, t.cktmsywlxmcjh as ywlx, t.bz as note from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.glh = #{ldlpNo}
select count(1) as tsjhTotal, sum(t.jsje) as tsjhAmt, sum(t.tse) as tsjhTsAmt, sum(t.zsse) as tsjhSe from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tsjh_lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.glh = #{ldlpNo}

select t.ckbgdh as bgdNo, t.dlzmh as dlzmNo, t.ckrq_1 as ljDate, t.cksp_dm as cmcode, t.sbhgspmc as cmname, t.hgjldwmc as cmunit, t.cksl as qnt, t.mylaj as usdAmt, t.ckjhje as ckjhAmt, t.tsl as tsl, t.zzstse as zzsTsAmt, t.xfstse as xfsTsAmt, t.cktmsywlxmcjh as ywlx, t.bz as note from tl_bjts.ckts_sb_mts_tssb_lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.glh = #{ldlpNo}

select t.sbxh as sbNo, t.ckfph as invNo, null as jxsDate, t.ckbgdh as bgdNo, t.ckrq_1 as ljDate, t.cksp_dm as cmcode, t.sbhgspmc as cmname, t.hgjldwmc as cmunit, t.sbsp_dm as sbcmcode, t.cksl as qnt, t.mylaj as usdAmt, t.rmblaj as rmbAmt, t.zssl as zssl, t.tsl as tsl, t.mdtsbdmzhdkse as ztsce, t.mdtse as tsAmt, t.jljgszch as hgdjcNo, t.cktmsywlxmcjh as ywlx from TL_BJTS.ckts_sb_mdt_tssb_lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.sbxh = #{ldlpNo}

select t.sbxh as sbNo, t.wtdbtsscqynsrsbh as wtNsrdjNo, t.ckbgdh as bgdNo, t.ckrq_1 as ljDate, t.cksp_dm as cmcode, t.sbsp_dm as sbCmcode, t.hgspmc as cmname, t.hgjldwmc as cmunit, t.cksl as qnt, t.mylaj as usdAmt, t.dbtswspzhm as zyfpNo, t.kprq as kpDate, t.jsje as rmbAmt, t.zssl, round(t.jsje * t.zssl/100,2) as se, t.tsl, t.tse as tsAmt, t.cktmsywlxmcjh as ywlx from TL_BJTS.Ckts_Sb_Db_Tssb_Lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.sbxh = #{ldlpNo}

select t.sbxh as sbNo, t.jhpzh as zyfpNo, t.gjzyhwmc as zyCmname, t.hgjldwmc as unit, t.sl as qnt, t.dj as pri, t.jsje as amt, t.zssl as zssl, t.se as se, t.tse as tsAmt, t.cktmsywlxmcjh as ywlx, t.kprq as kpDate, t.ghfnsrsbh_1 as ghfnsNo from TL_BJTS.Ckts_Sb_Gj_Sbmx_Lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.sbxh = #{ldlpNo}
select count(1) as dbtsTotal, sum(tse) as zyhwTsAmt, sum(se) as zyhwSe, sum(jsje) as zyhwAmt from TL_BJTS.Ckts_Sb_Gj_Sbmx_Lsb t where t.sbid = #{sbid} and t.sbxh = #{ldlpNo}
